'''Majoor penitentiary''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Majoor]]. Around [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Reddjak]] was imprisoned there.
